name: Juli
source:
Ema's pet squirrel who has the ability to talk. However, he can only talk to [url=/c10574]Ema[/url] and [url=/c12979]Louis[/url]. He has been with Ema since she was young, always looking out for her and making sure none of the brothers (or "wolves" as he considers them) make a pass at her. He always calls Ema "Chii". 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brothers_Conflict#Characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
